_meta.purpose: Four reports inserted at migration time so the Community Reports section is never empty. They carry seed = 1 and public = 1, and they describe message shapes the engine already models — the same families as content/threats.json.
_meta.rule: No names, no numbers, no institutions, no contact details. A seeded report reads exactly like a real anonymous one, because a real anonymous one holds nothing else either.

reports.description: Got an SMS saying I had an unpaid fine and had 24 hours to settle it through a link. The link was not on a government domain.
A work-from-home offer on WhatsApp, good salary, no interview, then they asked for a registration fee before anything started.
Someone called saying they were the bank's fraud department and asked me to read out the code that had just arrived on my phone.
A message said my account was suspended and one link would restore it. The sender was not a number I have ever had a message from.
